title.ru: Предлоги места и времени: in, on, at
title.en: Prepositions of place and time: in, on, at

pattern.en: The meeting is at ten on Monday.
The keys are on the table.

text.ru: Время: at — точное время и моменты (at 6, at night), on — дни и даты (on Friday, on 5 May), in — месяцы, годы, части дня (in June, in 2025, in the morning). Место: in — внутри (in the room, in Spain), on — на поверхности (on the wall, on the second floor), at — точка, место события (at the station, at work, at home). Куда — to: go to work (но go home).
text.en: Time: at for clock times (at 6), on for days and dates, in for months, years, parts of the day. Place: in = inside, on = on a surface, at = a point or venue (at work, at home). Direction: to (go to work, but go home).
text.es: Tiempo: at (hora), on (día), in (mes, año). Lugar: in (dentro), on (superficie), at (punto).

rule.formula: время: at 5, on Monday, in May · место: in (внутри), on (на поверхности), at (в точке)
